name: openmontage-remotion-composer
description: Remotion composition renderer for OpenMontage animated explainer videos

scripts.build: npx remotion render src/index.tsx Explainer out/video.mp4
scripts.verify:three:still: npx remotion still src/three/index.tsx ThreeJsSmoke out/threejs-smoke.png --frame=45 --gl=angle
scripts.verify:three:video: npx remotion render src/three/index.tsx ThreeJsSmoke out/threejs-smoke.mp4 --gl=angle
